text.en: Meena saw a forest, a desert and a pond in a book. "All life, but so different," she said.

The biosphere is the zone of life, where land, water and air meet. It includes plants, animals and microbes. Ecosystems are communities of living things and their surroundings, linked by food chains and food webs.
Major biomes include forests, grasslands, deserts and tundra, each with its own climate and life. Forests give wood and oxygen, grasslands support grazing and deserts have specially adapted plants.
Biodiversity, the variety of life, is under threat from forest loss and pollution. Protected areas such as national parks and biosphere reserves, for example the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve, help conserve it.
